title: When Marlowe Rewards Points Are Forfeited
content:
A positive Marlowe Rewards points balance is forfeited in full in two situations: when the account has gone a whole inactivity period without earning, and when the membership closes.

## Inactivity

The balance is forfeited when no earning entry has posted for the inactivity period, in calendar months, of the tier held. The forfeiture date is the day after a date found as follows:

1. Take the posting date of the latest earning entry. If there is none, take the enrolment date.
2. Add the tier's number of calendar months to it.
3. If that lands on a day the shorter month lacks, use the last day of that month.

Only earning entries count as activity, whether earned on a dispatched order or credited as a missing-points adjustment. Bonus, reversal and conversion entries do not count as activity.

## Closure

When a membership closes, any positive balance is forfeited on the closure date. The forfeiture reason is account closure when the customer closed the membership, or abuse closure when the review team closed it.

## Balances that are never forfeited

- A zero or negative balance is never forfeited, and a negative balance is not collected.
- Forfeited points are not reinstated, including when the customer enrols again.

## Worked dates (hypothetical periods and ledgers)

| Latest earning entry posted | Inactivity period assumed | Date reached | Forfeiture date |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 May 2024 | 12 months | 15 May 2025 | 16 May 2025 |
| 31 August 2024 | 18 months | 28 February 2026 (February has no 31st) | 1 March 2026 |
| none; enrolled 10 January 2024 | 24 months | 10 January 2026 | 11 January 2026 |

## Points of judgement

- **Bonuses do not reset the clock.** A member whose last earning entry was 15 May 2024 and who received a birthday bonus in June 2024 still reaches the 16 May 2025 forfeiture date, on a 12-month period.
- **Negative balances.** A member with a balance of minus 30 points at closure forfeits nothing and owes nothing.
